title: SHAMISA: SHAped Modeling of Implicit Structural Associations for Self-supervised No-Reference Image Quality Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2603.13669v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: No-Reference Image Quality Assessment (NR-IQA) aims to estimate perceptual quality without access to a pristine reference. Learning an NR-IQA model faces a fundamental bottleneck because it requires many costly human perceptual labels. We propose SHAMISA, a non-contrastive self-supervised framework that learns from unlabeled distorted images through explicitly structured relational supervision. Unlike prior methods that impose rigid binary similarity constraints, SHAMISA shapes soft, controllable implicit structural associations that are both distortion-aware and content-sensitive. A key innovation is its compositional distortion engine, which generates an uncountable family of degradations from continuous parameter spaces and groups the resulting images so that exactly one distortion factor varies at a time. translated_title: SHAMISA：面向自监督无参考图像质量评估的隐式结构关联塑形建模
translated_abstract: 无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）旨在在不获取原始参考图像的情况下估计感知质量。学习NR-IQA模型面临一个根本性瓶颈，因为它需要大量昂贵的人类感知标签。我们提出SHAMISA，一种非对比的自监督框架，通过显式结构化的关系监督从无标签的失真图像中学习。与先前施加僵化二元相似性约束的方法不同，SHAMISA塑造出柔软、可控的隐式结构关联，这些关联既感知失真又对内容敏感。其一个关键创新是组合式失真引擎，它从连续参数空间生成不可数的退化族，并对生成的图像进行分组，使得每次恰好只有一个失真因素发生变化。这一构造使得训练过程中能够对表征相似性进行细粒度控制。具有共享失……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SHAMISA，一种非对比自监督无参考图像质量评估框架，其核心创新是组合式失真引擎——从连续参数空间生成每次仅单一失真因素变化的图像分组，从而在训练中实现对表征相似性的细粒度塑形控制。
en_tdlr: SHAMISA is a non-contrastive self-supervised NR-IQA framework whose key innovation is a compositional distortion engine that generates degradations from continuous parameter spaces—grouping images so that exactly one distortion factor varies at a time—enabling fine-grained control over representational similarity during training.
